proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ _
  have hfin : {N : Subgroup G | N.Normal ∧ N ≠ ⊤}.Finite := Set.toFinite _
  have hne : {N : Subgroup G | N.Normal ∧ N ≠ ⊤}.Nonempty := ⟨⊥, inferInstance, bot_ne_top⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hfin.exists_maximal hne
  refine ⟨N, hN.prop.1, ?_⟩
  haveI : N.Normal := hN.prop.1
  have hx : ∃ x : G, x ∉ N := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_exists] at h
    exact hN.prop.2 ((Subgroup.eq_top_iff' N).mpr fun x => not_not.mp (h x))
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx
  have hnt : Nontrivial (G ⧸ N) :=
    ⟨⟨(x : G ⧸ N), 1, fun h => hx ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff x).mp h)⟩⟩
  refine { toNontrivial := hnt, eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_normal := ?_ }
  intro K hK
  by_cases hL : K.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) = ⊤
  · right
    rw [Subgroup.eq_top_iff']
    intro q
    induction q using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
    | H y =>
      have hy : y ∈ K.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by
        rw [hL]
        exact Subgroup.mem_top y
      exact hy
  · left
    have hle : K.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) ≤ N :=
      hN.le_of_ge ⟨hK.comap _, hL⟩ (QuotientGroup.le_comap_mk' N K)
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro q hq
    induction q using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
    | H y =>
      have hy : y ∈ K.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := hq
      exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff y).mpr (hle hy))
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] [Nontrivial G], ∃ N : Subgroup G, ∃ _ : N.Normal, IsSimpleGroup (G ⧸ N)
